the thunderer whose bolt, You know, sky-planted, Batters all rebelling coasts, Poor shadows
of Elysium, Hence and rest upon your never withering banks of floors, Be not with mortal
accidents oppressed, No care of yours it is, You know, tease ours, Whom best I love I cross,
